strings.name: Jürgen Schmidhuber
strings.summary: Schmidhuber studies recurrent neural networks, meta-learning and autonomous agents. He co-developed long short-term memory with Sepp Hochreiter, led research at Switzerland's IDSIA and co-founded NNAISENSE. His teams advanced sequence learning and visual recognition; he later moved to KAUST in Saudi Arabia to pursue AI research and teaching.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Co-developing LSTM
strings.highlights.h1.text: With Hochreiter, investigated gradients and memory in long sequences.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Connecting research and applications
strings.highlights.h2.text: Advanced neural network research and industrial applications at IDSIA and NNAISENSE.

strings.timeline.t2.title: Joining KAUST

strings.timeline.t3.title: Neural Networks Pioneer Award
strings.timeline.t3.text: The IEEE Computational Intelligence Society recognized his deep learning and neural network work.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Co-founding NNAISENSE

strings.timeline.t6.title: Publishing LSTM
strings.timeline.t6.text: Published long short-term memory research with Hochreiter in Neural Computation.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Moving to IDSIA

strings.timeline.t8.title: Completing a doctorate
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed doctoral research on dynamic neural networks at the Technical University of Munich.
